mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is active whenever the rate has fallen, regardless of its absolute level.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return distribution in periods of declining FEDFUNDS shows no significant positive bias compared to the overall distribution (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it indicates a slack labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Joint declines in housing starts and real consumer sales over the prior 3 months indicate a contraction in aggregate demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline condition (both HOUST and RSAFS declining) occurs in more than 40% of cases where SPX 20-day returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production exceeds 105.0 (index 2017=100), it signals robust economic output that supports corporate profitability, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.2%, it indicates an extreme monetary easing policy that reduces the risk-free rate and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return distribution in FEDFUNDS < 0.2% periods shows no significant positive bias (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 240.0, it indicates accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 240.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment and decline in unemployment rate over the prior 3 months indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling) occurs in more than 40% of cases where SPX 20-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth (as measured by the quarterly change in GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return distribution in periods of rising GDPC1 shows no significant positive bias (t-test p > 0.05).
